background_story: Orlando was a charismatic saloon owner in the Wild West town of Red Rock. His establishment, 'The Buckhorn', was famous for its rough-riding patrons and lively atmosphere. Behind the bar, Orlando kept a trusty spittoon, polished to a shine, where the regulars would deposit their chewing tobacco juice. One fateful evening, a notorious outlaw, 'Black Jack' McCoy, rode into town, looking for trouble. Orlando, sensing danger, positioned himself near the spittoon, ready to defend his patrons. As Black Jack drew his gun, Orlando swiftly grabbed the spittoon and used it to deflect the bullet, saving the lives of his customers. The incident cemented Orlando's reputation as a quick-thinking hero, and his spittoon became a legendary symbol of his bravery.
